answer: The admission bond is time locked for 17 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are written down in mesa, expire in island, and willow lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 179 aliases therefore needs 17 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 24 times over for the same share of the pool. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
